// diagnostic

E0721

A `{tag}` value is denied at `{api}`.

What

A `{tag}` value is denied at `{api}`.

Why

The declaration for `{tag}` lists a destination that covers `{api}`. The tag spreads with derived data until an exact-tag scrubber removes it.

Fix

remove the destination use, change the declaration if its policy is wrong, or pass the value through `#Scrub({tag})`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0721: tests/ui/crypto_secret_nested_provenance.stderr.

Error [E1004]: `core.crypto` exposes `Secret`, but not in this position
  --> tests/ui/crypto_secret_nested_provenance.jet:27:32
    |
 27 |     tagged :: #Reviewed crypto.Secret.from_text("tagged")
    |                                ^^^^^^
 Why: standard library modules expose a fixed set of public items, each reachable only where its surface declares
 Fix: import it directly with `use core.crypto.[Secret]`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1004

Error [E0119]: there's no type called `crypto.Secret`
  --> tests/ui/crypto_secret_nested_provenance.jet:37:25
    |
 37 |     callback :: (value: crypto.Secret) -> value
    |                         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: the types are `Int`, `Float`, `Bool`, and `String` (plus types you define)
 Fix: check the spelling, or define the struct or enum first
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0119

Error [E0721]: a `Reviewed` value is denied at `print`
  --> tests/ui/crypto_secret_nested_provenance.jet:29:5
    |
 29 |     print("{tagged}")
    |     ^^^^^
 Why: the declaration for `Reviewed` denies `Log`, which covers this destination
 Fix: remove the destination use, or pass the value through a matching `#Scrub(Reviewed)` function
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0721
